comments.author: Theodores
comments.story: Orkney islands could get first electric plane service
comments.why: Series on wind, hydrogen and big batteries in Orkney
comments.text: The Orkney Isles are setting the example in the UK. Going green and making progress with it is also quite good for the community, not to mention the balance sheet. Another future is definitely possible and the folks in the Orkney Isles are an inspiration. The Fully Charged Show on YouTube has been following progress for years, here is a recent three part series on wind, hydrogen and big batteries in the Orkney Isles: [VIDEO] I highly recommend liking, subscribing and giving a thumbs up to Fully Charged Show. Anyone that enjoyed Red Dwarf or Scrapheap Challenge will know the presenter.

comments.author: ZeroGravitas
comments.story: Scotland plans to make petrol and diesel cars obsolete by 2032
comments.why: Orkney renewables surplus encouraging EV uptake
comments.text: Islands are generally good for EVs, precisely because you can't drive that far. Orkney in particular has so much renewable energy that they're encouraging people to get EVs to soak up the excess because they have limited connectivity to export the excess back to the mainland: [VIDEO]
